## MetricsStore class

Lightweight in-process metrics store for runtime observability.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class MetricsStore 
```

## Remarks

Tracks update-level counters, per-listener hits, and latency percentiles in a plain object (no dependencies). Consumed by the `GET /stats` endpoint and by `onUpdateError`<!-- -->/log hooks. Not intended as a permanent telemetry backend — export the snapshot to your favorite metrics system instead.
